headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional for public tools. For protected AdCP operations, supply Bearer followed by a valid operator token. Keep the token secret.

https://vastlint.org/mcp.overview: VASTlint validates VAST, VMAP, and DAAST ad tags against IAB Tech Lab specifications. The six validation tools, get_adcp_capabilities, and the static list_content_standards catalog are public; account-scoped list_content_standards and the seven other content-standards or creative operations require authentication. For protected operations, configure the MCP client to send the optional Authorization header as Bearer <token> using a valid operator token. The hosted service may retain submitted XML after stripping known device IDs, IP addresses, and consent query parameters, and may request URLs in stored tags during research; the [privacy policy](https://vastlint.org/privacy/) describes storage, research use, and exclusion requests without specifying a fixed retention period. Use local vastlint-mcp over stdio to avoid hosted tag storage; this catalog version matches the hosted initialize response (0.9.0), rather than the previously listed package version (0.13.6).
